entry.name_in_paper: Flow cytometric analysis of long-term vaccine-specific CD4+ T helper phenotype
entry.readouts: frequencies of central memory CD4 T cells with Th1 or Th2 phenotype expressing intracellular CD154 after stimulation and restimulation

evidence.section: Flow cytometric analysis of IFN-γ/IL-2–producing activated CD4 T cells.
evidence.quote: To determine the T helper phenotype of long-term, vaccine-specific CD4 + T cells, 2 million PBMCs were stimulated for 6 d with YF17D peptide pools, and subsequently restimulated with the same pools for 12 h, in the presence of Brefeldin A.
